description: This file contains functions for preparing UBI devices and volumes for OpenWrt firmware upgrades specifically tailored for Buffalo devices. It handles attaching UBI partitions, removing and creating volumes, and updating firmware hash values.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes related to firmware and configuration, ensuring a clean state before upgrade.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Recreates essential UBI volumes and updates the firmware hash to validate the integrity during the upgrade process.
